khee01.title: Day 1: “I'm fine”
khee01.caption:
Day 1 doesn't need a brave face. Feeling it means it mattered, and asking someone to come sit on the floor with you counts as progress.
Fine can wait.

khee02.title: The hoodie
khee02.caption: Still sleeping in their hoodie? You don't have to throw it out. Fold it, box it, put it on a shelf, and wrap yourself in something that's yours.

khee03.title: Rereading the whole chat
khee03.caption: The answer isn't hiding in old messages. Archive the chat and start a new note instead: a list of things you like about you. Save this for the night you want to scroll back.

khee04.title: Dinner for two, by habit
khee04.caption: Set out two plates without thinking? That care didn't leave with them. Feed yourself first, then text a friend to come eat the extra.

khee05.title: The “thriving” selfie
khee05.caption: You don't owe anyone proof that you're okay. Put the phone down, call someone real, and heal where nobody's watching.
